status: CANDIDATES ONLY. Not part of any prompt or published vocabulary; prompt e3 remains the production enrichment prompt. Kept for a future prompt version (decided by Gavin, 2026-11-20).
format: proposed_terms entries use the seed's own entry shape (canonical, aliases, family_hint, ontology_mappings) so adoption is a copy, minus the 'candidate' block. proposed_aliases name the existing canonical they extend. proposed_excluded_kinds are regexes for EXCLUDED_KINDS in src/dome_triage/llm_classify/enrichment_e2.py (flag, never drop).

source.backup: private runs repository dome-observatory-enrichment-runs, events/<cohort>/ (commit c50dde2)

method.tag_count: model_type tags in parse_status=ok events whose lower-cased value matches the candidate's pattern (spellings listed in observed_spellings); records = distinct papers.
method.zenodo_positives_mentioning: positives in the Zenodo dump whose title or abstract matches the candidate's text patterns, counted once per paper: the basis e3's inclusion rule used (scripts/e3_term_evidence.py). Not the same population as tag_count.
method.family_hint: every hint names existing model_family labels (checked).

adoption: See curation_criteria/candidates/README.md: adopting any of this is a new prompt version (AGENTS.md rule 1), not an edit to e3.
